source: Style sample: the real sim-demo-2 run from orchestrator-demo-feed.json, rewritten in the plain-language format the orchestrator now uses. Not a live recording.
goal: Deliver slugify + truncate string utils, each independently verified.

items.text: 🏏 Plan: build **two small text helpers**, each checked by someone other than its builder.
🤔 Running both jobs **at the same time**: they don't touch the same files.
🚀 Started: a checker for **slugify** and a builder for **truncate**, using the ==cheapest== model.
✅ **Slugify accepted**: the independent check passed on its own.
📦 Truncate is built and its own test passes. Now a **separate checker** confirms it.
🛑 The checker finished but **wrote no report**, so I can't trust it yet.
🔁 Asking the checker **once more**, this time with a required report format.
🏆 **Both helpers accepted**, ==2 of 2==, in under two minutes for less than a cent.
